notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/ca4954ff1186270b92bf3c930c068641ce4e4fb8.png[/img]
Dear friends, Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays! We thank you once again and wish you all the best!
We want to bring you the happy news that next year we plan to release about 4 projects, which are now in the process of active development. Among them is, of course, everyone's favorite Find All.  And also we take part in the Steam Next Fest with our new the game CatBox.
P.s Find all planned two parts! :3
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2655740/CatBox/?utm_mc

notes.title: Very Very Little Studio is now in 3d!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40571956/9ebe02bb22a690cb72d78c6658c8d60bc4b37255.png[/img]
Hi there! Our new game has come out in a new format for us. Hurry up to try out another genre of puzzles - search for differences on dioramas in 3d. Thank you for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2085040/ToriDori/

notes.title: Hurry up and play Find All 4: Magic (DEMO)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287348/e7bed7bdb9eb7036d335e5fc276f899db5823066.png[/img]
We are pleased to announce the release of the demo version of Find All 4: Magic. The new part of the game is made on the basis of previous experience and your suggestions. Thank you for your support!
In the demo version you will find 190 search items and 2 puzzles.

At the moment there will be only three languages in the Demo version, but in the main version of the game there will be many more!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2260670/?=3d

notes.title: ToriDori's new game participates in the festival!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287348/003ba05dfddfd54511be272ded5e31d14b590d31.png[/img]
Hello! Our new game is participating in the festival. Since our team is gradually expanding, we decided to try ourselves in 3D and in the genre of finding differences, but with its own features. Of course, we don't forget about the Find All series. The fourth part is already being worked on. You can support us and try to play the demo version of ToriDori. We hope you like it! Thank you so much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146010/ToriDori/?=fa3

notes.title: New update: Helper hamster!
notes.notes:
A helper hamster has been added, which has a map of the city, and sometimes he will be able to suggest the approximate location of objects!)

[b]Added:[/b]
- Help in the game every 3 minutes.
[b]Changed:[/b]
- Now you can choose any difficulty level right from the start of the game.
- In the description of the achievements, it is precisely indicated on which difficulty levels you can get the achievement.
[b]Fixed:[/b]
- Minor fixes with the location of objects.

notes.title: Added 6 languages!
notes.notes:
Added 6 languages!

Thanks to those who helped with the translations:
Czech translated by siSINka_CZ.
Norwegian translated by Guyra.
Dutch translated by Charlotte.
Polish translated by zell.san.
Irish and French translated by default.

Minor bugs have also been fixed.

notes.title: Now available on macOS and Linux! As well as control with a gamepad!
notes.notes:
Added:
- Now available on macOS and Linux!
- Play with a gamepad!

[u]Update the game for the updates to take effect.[/u]

notes.title: Game optimization update! :)
notes.notes:
Corrected:
- Now the game will not eat your computer's RAM.
- If you completed 7 levels before opening the last two, then when you enter the game you will receive achievements: Roses, Lizards, Cheese!)

I also want to say thanks to all the players who reported errors, thanks to you I was able to learn a lot of new things, and I can continue to please you with new games! )

notes.title: The last two levels are open again! Fixed minor bugs.
notes.notes:
Fixed:
- Wrong word on the box in the train.
- Offset of numbers on some monitor resolutions.
- Corrected the position of objects.
- Getting three achievements.
- Adjusted the last two levels.

Work in progress:
- Increased performance on some devices.
- Errors when starting on weak PCs.

notes.title: A small list of fixes and temporarily disabling the last two levels.
notes.notes:
Fixed 1 level on normal.
Fixed travel on normal.
Temporarily disabled the last two levels for adjustments and corrections, we apologize.
